description: Runtime control of the Flow engine (does NOT change flows.jsn): enable / disable a rule until the next reload or restart (use myio_flow_save en=0|1 to make it permanent), fire = run its THEN chain now (WHEN/AND skipped), set_var = set global variable id (1..32) to value (variable triggers are evaluated). The answer shows the outputs that changed and the trace. Editor/admin level.

id.description: flow id, or the variable id for set_var

name: myio_flow
title: Run / switch a Flow rule
